title: Release plain-english-styles v0.2.0 (14 commits ahead of v0.1.0)
summary: Cut the next release of plain-english-styles from dev (14 commits ahead of v0.1.0, measured by gh compare 2026-10-26: operator-questions skill, Mermaid mod, decision-question checks). Bump plugin.json to 0.2.0, land on dev, promote to main by fast-forward, tag v0.2.0 (annotated), then move the opum-marketplace pin and baseline (OMARK task).

acceptanceCriteria.text: plugin.json on the tagged commit declares version 0.2.0
main is a fast-forward of the gated dev and the annotated tag v0.2.0 peels to that commit
opum-marketplace pin and federated-pin baseline name v0.2.0 with the resolved subtree SHAs

finalSummary: Released v0.2.0. PR #58 (squash 2a06e85f) bumped plugin.json to 0.2.0; dev was fast-forwarded to main (bf3f253 -> 2a06e85f, PR #59 auto-marked MERGED); annotated tag v0.2.0 (tag object fe3dcee8) peels to 2a06e85f. The repository has no branch rules or required checks, so no CI ran on any of it. The marketplace pin moved to v0.2.0 in opum-ai/opum-marketplace#229 (OMARK-100), whose required checks were green.
